description: Consolidated catalog of high-leverage agent skills across platform workflows, headless runners, and project bridges.

skills.name: agy-headless
skills.description: Execute Google Antigravity (agy) non-interactively via print mode (`agy -p`) with granular control over models (gemini-3.8-flash, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-6-thinking, gpt-oss-120b-medium), reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max), execution modes (auto, accept-edits, plan), permission auto-approval, output formatting (json, text, stream-json), structured schema validation, Windows command line length safety, and conversation resumption.

skills.name: claude-headless
skills.description: Execute Anthropic Claude Code non-interactively via print mode (`claude -p`) with fine-grained control over models (claude-3-7-sonnet, claude-3-5-haiku, claude-3-opus), tool whitelisting (--allowed-tools), permission skipping, system prompt overrides, output formatting (json, text), minimal execution mode (--bare), and session continuity.

skills.name: codex-headless
skills.description: Execute OpenAI Codex non-interactively via `codex exec` with precise control over model (gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6.1-terra, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-luna), reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra), sandbox permissions (read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access), structured JSON output schemas, directory context, git worktrees, image inputs, and thread resumption.

skills.name: engineering-orchestrator
skills.description:
Use this skill whenever orchestrating software engineering projects, managing multi-agent workflows,
defining canonical roles (Architect, Implementor, Reviewer, Executor), inventing novel specialized roles on demand,
enforcing dual-gate review/execution verification, or governing subagent lifecycle and compute costs.

skills.name: github-pr-workflow
skills.description: Complete GitHub Pull Request and CI workflow automation: zero-dependency GitHub API interactions (via pure Python urllib), safe multi-line comment publishing from file (preventing shell quoting corruption), CI run failure & test digestion (<=50 lines), PR comment polling and role watching, HEAD SHA matching, and local git clean status verification.

skills.name: hub-messenger
skills.description: Zero-model messenger daemon and self-wake waiter for Trishul Agent Hub. Periodically polls participant inboxes and wakes idle workers with unread mail via detached CLI resumption, in-session self-wait (hub_wait), or logging, eliminating expensive model-turn polling chats.

skills.name: pr-handoff-lifecycle
skills.description: Use this skill to draft, validate, and verify PR role handoffs ([IMPLEMENTOR-1], [COORDINATOR], [REVIEWER-1A/B]) directly from git history, diffs, and NUnit test report XMLs.

skills.name: unity-pipeline
skills.description: Unified Unity C# engineering, verification, and testing pipeline. Integrates machine-wide Unity execution locking, exact ProjectVersion editor resolution, mandatory fast-fail static contract audits (<1s), fast C# compilation pre-checks, targeted batchmode test execution (EditMode/PlayMode), NUnit 3 XML report parsing, automated Editor.log failure diagnostics extraction, and composite phase gates into a single authoritative tool.

skills.name: chatgpt-role-bridge
skills.description:
Temporary project-local bridge enabling ORCHESTRATOR-LOCAL to communicate with persistent
cloud ChatGPT roles (such as DESIGN_OWNER and REVIEWER) via the proven PoC-001 Session Host.
Use when coordinating Phase 2 architecture freeze, Gate 1 design approval, or exact-SHA code
reviews with cloud roles without manual copy-pasting.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Check and act on file handoffs in trishul-agent-hub. Use when asked to check handoffs, or on the 15-minute cron check, to pick up any package whose next_owner is antigravity.

skills.name: tte-batch-brief
skills.description: Concise template and guidelines used by the project manager to brief an orchestrator for a 2-4 step work batch. Defines base branch & SHA, step table with risk tier and model, governing rules, carried-forward phase-list items, reporting requirements, and wait/idle boundaries.

skills.name: tte-batch-review
skills.description: Lean batch-review procedure for TTE reviewers and orchestrators. Enforces one joint review of tests and code together, a single recheck of changed items only by the same reviewer, strict blocker criteria (player-facing, replay/save-state breakage, or unexplained outcome pin moves), differential note validation, and standardized verdict reporting.

skills.name: tte-content-pipeline
skills.description: Create, validate, and bake game content definition assets and register entries in the correct content-pack paths using scripts/validate_content_asset.py. Use when adding or changing units, weapons, sensors, factions, missions, or register values. Implementor or executor role.

skills.name: tte-golden-recapture
skills.description: Recapture and re-baseline golden simulation pins once per batch under the accepted G02 lean process using TTE_GOLDEN_ACTUAL_DIR and ci/golden-recapture.py with a differential note table. Implementor role.

skills.name: tte-phase-evidence
skills.description: Assemble and verify the phase-end acceptance review package for the architect (preconditions, step commit table, CI run status, state-inventory diff, deviations) using scripts/assemble_phase_evidence.py. Use when all steps of a phase are complete. Orchestrator role.

skills.name: tte-phase-merge
skills.description: Safely merge side/task branches into the active TTE phase branch with a non-fast-forward merge commit (--no-ff). Enforces clean working tree, blocks unapproved ProjectSettings/Packages changes, shows merge-base and diff preview, pushes only on demand with --push, and polls for GitHub Actions CI run ID. Strictly prohibits force-pushes and touching main.

skills.name: tte-status
skills.description: Authoritative TTE project status reporter. Outputs complete waking state in <=60 lines (phase branch head SHA, CI run & job conclusions, open PRs, top 8 remote branches by recency, ahead/behind main divergence, last 3 comments on phase PR and question issue cut to ~200 chars, and local worktrees). Uses only git and gh.
